authorization: 先保留EP36-78的原特征，然后以Rank IC为目标训练模型。
features: Exact ordered 78 EP36 core columns; original formulas and raw scales; no feature selection or cross-sectional input rank transformation
preprocessing: Train-only median imputation, mean and population sd; original EP36 TrainTransform
training_signals: Original EP36 weekly observations, not H10 subsampling
training_eligibility: Original EP36 score_eligible and mature nonmissing target_z
outer: Quarterly expanding 2021Q1 through 2026Q4; label maturity <= prior quarter end
inner_purge: Inner labels must exit strictly before first validation entry; both partitions mature before outer cutoff

models.E1_78: Original EP36 Ridge return-z MSE, alpha=10; numerical reproduction baseline
models.RANK_MSE_78: Ridge alpha=10 on per-date centered return ranks; diagnostic baseline, not RankIC loss
models.RIC_78: Linear 78-dimensional score; minimize negative date-mean differentiable Spearman surrogate; select positive training step by exact validation mean RankIC
models.JR_11: Frozen EP37 J_R predictions; evaluate on common H10 universe; no retraining

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.sampling: Seeded shuffled date cycles; equal weight per date in each batch
optimizer.warm_start: Ridge(alpha=10) return-z weights fitted on the SAME training partition
optimizer.normalization: Coefficient unit norm after every step; score centered and population-sd normalized within each date
optimizer.loss: Negative mean per-date Pearson correlation of soft prediction ranks and exact average target ranks
optimizer.selection: Maximum exact validation date-mean Spearman RankIC at steps 30,60,120; tie -> fewer steps; no selection by outer performance
optimizer.refit: Fit preprocessing and Ridge warm-start on all mature weekly history, then train chosen step count with fixed optimizer and seed

evaluation.label: qfq_open[t+11]/qfq_open[t+1]-1
evaluation.main_universe: Frozen EP37 offset0 primary eligible stocks intersect >=80% original core feature availability; no future label filtering
evaluation.weekly_secondary: Original EP36 score-eligible weekly universe; evaluation only, not a second trading strategy
evaluation.continuous_accounts: E1_78, RIC_78, RANK_MSE_78, JR_11 D10 and TOP20; common-universe EW
evaluation.execution: Reuse frozen EP37 H10 lot engine, liquidate and rebuy at each H10 boundary, actual gates, blocked exit carry and retry
evaluation.flat_boundary: Only confirmed full-day suspensions, maximum20 sessions; other unknown held quote stops account

statistics.bootstrap: Circular moving whole H10 date blocks; NA slots retained; paired support
